about_the_game:
When FBI trainee Ethan Nolan loses contact with his dad, he travels to a remote house in New England to find out what's going on. What starts as a simple search for his missing father turns into a nightmare full of family secrets and dark forces trying to destroy everything.

Find your way through lies and tricks as you try to discover what happened to your father. Laura Bennett, your dad's new wife, and her two daughters, Mel and Chloe, seem to know something, but their friendly behavior hides dangerous plans.

About this DEMO:

  • This demo introduces you to Ethan's journey as he arrives at the mysterious house where the story unfolds. Experience the tense atmosphere of Day 1 as you begin to uncover the first clues and establish relationships with key characters that will shape your adventure.

  • Navigate through detailed environments with intuitive controls, giving you a taste of the full game's exploration mechanics and interaction systems.

  • Engage in meaningful dialogue choices that offer a glimpse of how your decisions can influence character relationships and story developments in the complete version.

  • Experience carefully crafted, intimate moments that showcase the game's mature content, featuring high-quality animated sex scenes that blend seamlessly with the narrative.

  • The Objectives Menu system will guide your progress, helping you track current goals and next steps as you explore the house and interact with its inhabitants.

  • This condensed experience delivers approximately 20-30 minutes of gameplay, offering a perfect preview of the full game's atmosphere, visual style, and core mechanics.

  • Note: Achievements, saving, and loading systems are disabled in this demo version.

In Tenebris Legion, nothing seems to be right. Trust no one, question everything, and hope you survive long enough to learn the truth about your father's fate—and your own family's dark past.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters depicted in the game are over the age of 18.
The game contains content not appropriate for all ages: nudity, sexual acts, strong language, BDSM scenes with mild violence, sexual assault, and dubious consent.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or higher
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7/i9 (2019 or later), Apple M1 Pro / M2 or later
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: FBI trainee Ethan Nolan travels to a remote house to find his missing father. In this first-person adventure set in 1988, explore the Bennett family home, solve puzzles, and uncover dark secrets. Nothing is what it seems in this supernatural mystery.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
